dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Pear Upside-Down Cake was brought to the Care Centers as a stray, so her behavior in a previous home environment is unknown. In the Care Centers, she has displayed fearful behaviors, including hard barking and growling when unfamiliar people approach her. However, with slow, patient interactions, she has gradually warmed up to select staff members. Due to her fearful behaviors, Pear Upside-Down Cake is recommended for placement in an adult-only home through a New Hope Partner who can provide a supportive environment and address her behavioral needs using positive reinforcement-based training.
dog.name: Pear Upside-Down Cake
